about: subject.isM2M as the whole condition or target. access-control 6.1.6 accepts it as the whole condition of a simplified policy (g8a-subject-is-m2m, sx-is-m2m-alone and others, 400 before), and its three new goldens ask parity-reader only, false. Beside a connective in a set's rule condition it is true for the M2M token alone (s18q-is-m2m-*). Each case asks the M2M token alone, parity-reader, and parity-r29-level-m2m, a user whose token carries the claim level m2m (testdata/realm/round29-pipfield-users.json and the level mapper of the parity realm).

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.

Control: a simplified policy for READ with the roles ROLE_PARITY_READER and ROLE_M2M, whose condition holds. All three requests answer true if each subject reaches the policy by its roles; a false here makes the other simplified cases of the file say nothing for that subject.

A simplified policy for READ with the roles of the control and the condition subject.isM2M alone. m2m true and reader false mean it checks that the subject is a service account; m2m false means the whole condition is never true; level-m2m true means a user token whose level claim is m2m counts as one.

The same policy with subject.isM2M OR resource.a == 'y', asked with a = n: the operand beside a connective, which the M2M token alone makes true in a set's rule condition (s18q-is-m2m-*); no golden asks it in a simplified policy. level-m2m true means a user token whose level claim is m2m counts as a service account whether or not the condition is whole.

An ACTIVE top-level set whose policy (target true) holds one ALLOW rule with condition subject.isM2M. m2m true and reader false mean it checks that the subject is a service account; m2m false means it is never true; a refused upload means the PAP takes subject.isM2M alone in a simplified policy only.

The same set, the ALLOW rule with target subject.isM2M and condition true. m2m true and reader false mean it checks that the subject is a service account; m2m false means it is never true; a refused upload means the PAP takes subject.isM2M alone in a simplified policy only.

The same set, the policy with target subject.isM2M and an ALLOW rule with condition true. m2m true and reader false mean it checks that the subject is a service account; m2m false means it is never true; a refused upload means the PAP takes subject.isM2M alone in a simplified policy only.

A top-level set whose target is subject.isM2M alone, with a policy (target true) and an ALLOW rule with condition true. The target names no resource type, so the set applies to every type: the case comes last before the closing control, which asks parity-reader. m2m true and reader false mean it checks that the subject is a service account; m2m false means it is never true; a refused upload means the PAP takes subject.isM2M alone in a simplified policy only.
